incident_details.description: Dr. Ramesh Chandra reported an unauthorized siphoning of corporate treasury funds amounting to INR 8.40 Crores through compromised digital payment credentials. The funds were disbursed across multiple beneficiary bank accounts at ICICI, HDFC, and SBI within a 45-minute window following a phishing lure and rogue banking token takeover.
